notes.title: Patch 0.0.24.Alpha Demo
notes.content:
[p]Hi adventurers ! ✨
We’ve just released a small update to improve your experience in [b]Glimvale[/b]. Here’s what’s new :[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Content[/h3][list][*][p]Added new decorations[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced two new decoration combos[/p][/*][*][p]Added flame FX to certain torch decorations 🔥[/p][/*][*][p]New event that appears at a specific quest, spawns BOT adventurers[/p][/*][/list][h3]Interface[/h3][list][*][p]Added a tooltip explaining the [b]difficulty system[/b] (the D20) in the building info panel[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]list of adventurers currently inside a building[/b] directly in its info panel[/p][/*][/list][h3]Debug[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed minor issues with panels staying open when they shouldn’t[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some states not resetting properly[/p][/*][/list][h3]Buildings[/h3][list][*][p]Alchemist building is now smaller -> easier to decorate around it ✨[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty system reworked :[/p][list][*][p][b]Before[/b]: each building had its own base difficulty, and when an adventurer picked an item, the check was building difficulty + item difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Now[/b]: each purchased item license inside a building increases its total difficulty (if applicable). This makes things simpler and more consistent ![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]That's all for now ! 
Thank you so much for playing and sharing your feedback <3 Your support helps us make the game much better![/p][p]This update takes into account a lot of your feedback ! <3 <3 Thank you ✨✨[/p][p]We still have work to do to improve it.[/p][p]Don't forget to leave us a wishlist on Steam if you haven't already ![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd4AX0bqHg7oA1kPrwBZcH7RZ4sCfEE70WgZsagdM6aNloBFg/viewform?usp=dialog"]Google Form, we need your feedbacks[/url]  [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3403590/Glimvale__My_Mini_Overworld/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

tags.feature: Added flame FX to certain torch decorations 🔥
New event that appears at a specific quest, spawns BOT adventurers
Added a tooltip explaining the [b]difficulty system[/b] (the D20) in the building info panel
Added a [b]list of adventurers currently inside a building[/b] directly in its info panel

tags.bug: Fixed minor issues with panels staying open when they shouldn’t
Fixed some states not resetting properly

tags.balance_change: Alchemist building is now smaller -> easier to decorate around it ✨
[b]Before[/b]: each building had its own base difficulty, and when an adventurer picked an item, the check was building difficulty + item difficulty.
[b]Now[/b]: each purchased item license inside a building increases its total difficulty (if applicable). This makes things simpler and more consistent !

notes.title: Major Update for demo, more chill ! 🌿
notes.content:
[h1]Major Update for demo, more chill 🌿🌿🌿[/h1][p]Hello game master ! 👋
We’re happy to announce a [b]big new update[/b] for Glimvale, focused on making the game [b]simpler, cozier, and more enjoyable[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p]The public demo is updated ! Come test it and give us feedback :)🌿[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Gameplay & Balance[/h2][list][*][p]No more upkeep costs for selling licenses — manage your village with less stress and more freedom.[/p][/*][*][p]Adventurers’ tastes (items & activities) now evolve earlier, starting from Quest 6 instead of Quest 8, making progression smoother.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted item costs & profits for better balance and pacing.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45429033/32de089f2fac67eccdd81fd236d90027ffac6311.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]New Content & Customization[/h2][list][*][p]Added new decoration items to personalize your village even more ![/p][/*][*][p]You can now change the ground of the village center, perfect for giving your hub a fresh look.[/p][/*][*][p]We can place small houses[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45429033/3b1c976e25aa0b74d0abf92334397a4eacfa09ed.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🐾 Cozy Features[/h2][list][*][p]You can now [b]pet and cuddle animals[/b] in your village ! 💖
(Because what’s a cozy game without pets?)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Tutorial & Guidance[/h3][list][*][p]Expanded the [b]tutorial questline[/b] to better guide new players as they start their adventure.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fixes & Polish[/h3][list][*][p]Small adjustments and fixes to text and UI for a smoother experience.[/p][p]
[/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3403590/Glimvale__My_Mini_Overworld/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

tags.balance_change: No more upkeep costs for selling licenses — manage your village with less stress and more freedom.
Adventurers’ tastes (items & activities) now evolve earlier, starting from Quest 6 instead of Quest 8, making progression smoother.
Adjusted item costs & profits for better balance and pacing.

tags.feature: Added new decoration items to personalize your village even more !
You can now change the ground of the village center, perfect for giving your hub a fresh look.

You can now pet and cuddle animals in your village ! 💖
(Because what’s a cozy game without pets?)
Expanded the tutorial questline to better guide new players as they start their adventure.

tags.bug: Small adjustments and fixes to text and UI for a smoother experience.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.23.Alpha Demo
notes.content: [h3]BALANCING[/h3][list][*][p]The cost of item sales licenses has been balanced. (Much cheaper.)[/p][/*][*][p]Chests now yield twice as much gold.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]FUNCTIONALITY[/h3][p]The demo and playtests are already bringing changes.[/p][list][*][p]The patch feature, inspired by Anno 1800, has been cut, overcomplicating the game for little gain.[/p][/*][*][p]The crafting mechanic has been revised; it now only allows you to earn gold. (The patch ingredients have been removed.) [/p][/*][*][p]More feedback on the change in adventurers' favorite activities.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a talent tree to show decoration rewards based on village levels[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Glimvale's public demo is available ! x Best Indie Games✨
notes.content:
It's time to discover Glimvale, our charming little game still in alpha 🌸
The Glimvale demo is available for two weeks. Thanks again to Best Indie Games for their support.
We're working hard on the game, and we can't wait to show you more.🌸

Explore, decorate, build, and enjoy a first glimpse of the Glimvale experience !
We have just added "combo" effects for decorations, by combining certain decorations, you will be able to summon a duck, a frog, the king of cats, etc.
We've also added panels with more information, improved the tutorial, tooltips, and explanations, and added new content !
